atoms.b: Miss Smith, how does food become energy in our bodies?
That’s a great question Gabriel. In order to understand how food becomes energy, we need to understand ((++digestion respiration excretion)).

Digestion describes the process of ((++breaking_down building_up glueing_together)) everything we eat into nutrients. The digestion process also creates ((++waste hair blood)), which we must remove from our bodies regularly.
Nutrients help us live! The body uses them for ((++energy light oxygen)), growth and healing from injuries.
Wow! Digestion sounds fascinating. Where in the body does it happen?

Digestion is a ((++complex simple quick)) process with different steps. Digestion starts as soon as we put food in our mouth and doesn’t end until we have removed the waste. Digestion occurs in ((++many_different just_two)) organs.
Wait a minute, what is an organ?

You already know the name of some organs. Your ((++stomach teeth nails)), heart and lungs are organs, and so is your tongue. All the organs that help ((++process look_at smell)) food are called digestive organs.
That’s so interesting! I’m excited to learn more.

feedback.end: Food digestion takes a long time! It can take anywhere between 24 and 72 hours for your body to fully break down food.

atoms.a: How long do you think it takes for your body to digest food and excrete the waste?

instruction.text: Spell the body parts that make up the digestive system.

finish.text: The saliva in your mouth releases an enzyme which helps break down food.
The teeth break food into smaller pieces.
The tongue mixes the food with saliva into a slippery ball and pushes it to the back of the throat.

feedback.finish: The oesophagus is a tube that brings the food down to the stomach.

finish.text: The stomach uses acid to break down food into a liquid.
The intestines break down food even more and get rid of waste. This is also when nutrients from the food are absorbed into the blood stream.
